body:
Thanks everyone for attending! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8446):

### Agenda

1. Review past action items
    1. None
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. Emilio will ping the patch author for [focus delegate code seems wrongly only looking at children](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8157) or take over and send the patch to Olli.
        1. Done, tests and everything.
    1. Joey will land a change to change Chromium's behavior around [Event bubbling on disabled form elements](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5886).
        1. Change landed, likely shipping in Chrome M109.

1. New topics
    1. [Dominic] [autocomplete attribute for street-address details](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4986)
        1. Dominic collected [a lot of data](https://battre.github.io/autocomplete-attribute-explainer/). Looking for engineers from other browsers to join a half day workshop to dig deeper into the problem. Ollie and Emilio to find a Firefox rep, Anne to find a Safari rep.
    1. [Emilio] [Make the focus fixup rule more explicit](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8392)
        1. Anne will find the WebKit experts and confirm that they are OK with the timing proposal. Mason or Joey to add feedback on what Blink is using for removal.
    1. [Anne] [Align with DOM DocumentFragment adoption changes](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/5413)
        1. Didn't have time for this.
    1. [Joey] [New feature proposal: Popup API](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/7785)
        1. Didn't have time for this.

### Action Items

1. @smaug---- and @emilio to find a Firefox rep, @annevk to find a Safari rep for a longer discussion of [autocomplete attribute for street-address details](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4986).
1. @annevk will find the WebKit experts and confirm that they are OK with the timing proposal to [make the focus fixup rule more explicit](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8392). @mfreed7 or @josepharhar to add feedback on what Blink is using for removal.
